scope: Maintainer passive power observation on the physical phone after code35 installation; not a Muse task regression or completed demo recording.

environment.actor: Maintainer using original trusted wireless ADB for passive diagnostics
environment.recording_timing_basis: Maintainer sequence: the new Muse demo recording began only after this monitor completed. Its outcome remains pending in this report.

upgrade.actor: Maintainer same-signature in-place installation, not Muse autonomous upgrade
upgrade.original_pairing_boundary: No clear/revoke during installation. Muse use of the original pairing requires its own command evidence, not the power samples.

monitor.lock_match: Monitor matched the SCREEN_DIM_WAKE_LOCK line for Airtap:TrustedPhone, not an arbitrary application wake lock.
monitor.method: Version and hardware identity checked read-only before sampling; the interval repeatedly read dumpsys power and slept one second between reads. No injected UI input, wake command or setting change.
monitor.result: All 67 sampled states were Awake with the Airtap authorized-screen lock held over a window longer than the original 60-second lease.
monitor.limits: Discrete samples do not prove every instant between samples. This short interval is not multi-day stability, a disconnect recovery, a physical stop/revoke check, or proof that the code34 CANCEL was caused by the prior lease gap.

related_evidence.boundary: Code34 functional outcomes remain tied to code34; the code35 power check does not repeat the input, gesture, volume, file or system chooser suite.
